textNodes.text: Every team I worked with had two sets of design tokens: the ones in Figma and the ones in code, slowly drifting apart.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: I wanted one button that makes them the same again, in either direction, with a readable diff before anything changes.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: A Figma plugin written in TypeScript. It reads local variables, writes a tokens.json in the W3C format and opens a pull request through the GitHub API.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Reads Figma variables and modes, not styles
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Shows a diff before writing anything
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Opens a pull request instead of pushing to main
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Open source, used by eleven teams I know of
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Sync tools fail on trust, not on code. People only press the button when they can see exactly what it will change.
